qe: The classical dance form Bharatanatyam, originally known as Sadir or Dasi Attam, developed in which region and was revived in the twentieth century mainly through the efforts of which person?
qh: शास्त्रीय नृत्य भरतनाट्यम, जिसे पहले सादिर या दासी अट्टम कहा जाता था, किस क्षेत्र में विकसित हुआ और बीसवीं सदी में मुख्यतः किसके प्रयासों से पुनर्जीवित हुआ?
e: Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ke mandiron ki devadasi parampara se nikla; purane naam Sadir ya Dasi Attam the. Beesvin sadi me ise samajik apmaan aur patan se nikal kar manch par lane ka bada shrey Rukmini Devi Arundale ko jaata hai, jinhone 1936 me Chennai ke paas Kalakshetra sansthan ki sthapna ki aur is nritya ko shastriya roop diya. Kerala ka pramukh shastriya nritya Kathakali hai aur Vallathol Narayana Menon ne Kerala Kalamandalam (1930) se usse punarjeevit kiya - isliye pehla vikalp dono hisson se galat hai. Vempati Chinna Satyam Kuchipudi ke prasiddh guru the, jo Andhra Pradesh ka nritya hai, Bharatanatyam ka nahi. Manipuri nritya Manipur rajya ka hai aur Jhaveri bahnein uski prasiddh kalakar thi. Is tarah yeh prashn nritya, uske rajya aur punarjeevan-karta ke sahi jode ko test karta hai. Exam point: Bharatanatyam = Tamil Nadu, purana naam Sadir/Dasi Attam, punarjeevan Rukmini Devi Arundale aur Kalakshetra se.

qe: The Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's national academy of performing arts, was set up in which year and confers which of the following awards?
qh: भारत की राष्ट्रीय निष्पादन कला अकादमी, संगीत नाटक अकादमी किस वर्ष स्थापित हुई और निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पुरस्कार प्रदान करती है?
oe: 1952; Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and Akademi Ratna (Akademi Puraskar)
oh: 1952; संगीत नाटक अकादमी पुरस्कार तथा अकादमी रत्न (अकादमी पुरस्कार)
e: Sangeet Natak Akademi bharat ki rashtriya sangeet, nritya tatha natak ki akademy hai; iski sthapna 1952 me hui aur iska mukhyalay New Delhi me hai. Yeh sansthan Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (akademi puraskar) tatha Akademi Ratna (akademi fellowship) naam ke samman deti hai, jisse kalakaron aur vidwanon ka samman hota hai. Sahitya Akademi saahitya (literature) ke liye 1954 me bani alag sanstha hai aur uska puraskar Sahitya Akademi Award hota hai, isliye 1954 wala vikalp galat hai kyunki woh kala-vibhag ke liye nahi hai. Bharat Ratna bharat ka sabse bada nagrik samman hai aur Padma Vibhushan doosra sabse bada; inhe rashtrapati prashasti ke tehat alag samiti ki sifarish par diya jaata hai, yeh kisi akademy ke puraskar nahi hain. Isliye saal tatha puraskar ka sahi joda hi is prashn ki khas baat hai. Exam point: Sangeet Natak Akademi = 1952, kalakaron ke liye Award tatha Akademi Ratna; Sahitya Akademi = 1954 (sahitya), Lalit Kala Akademi = 1954 (kala).

qe: Among the languages recognised as 'classical languages' by the Government of India, which was the first to receive that status, and in which year?
qh: भारत सरकार द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त 'शास्त्रीय भाषाओं' में सबसे पहले किस भाषा को और किस वर्ष यह दर्जा मिला?
e: Bharat sarkar 'shastriya bhasha' (classical language) ka darja un bhashaon ko deti hai jinki sahitya parampara sadiyon purani ho aur jinka pranit roop apne aap vikasit hua ho. Pehla darja Tamil ko 2004 me mila; iske baad Sanskrit ko 2005 me, Telugu aur Kannada ko 2008 me, Malayalam ko 2013 me tatha Odia ko 2014 me yahi darja mila. Isliye Sanskrit 2005 sahi saal hai lekin woh pehli bhasha nahi thi - pehla sthan Tamil ka hai; isi karan woh vikalp galat ho jaata hai. Achhi baat yeh hai ki is prakar ka prashn samanya tatha rajya stariya pratiyogita parikshaon me baar-baar aata hai, kyunki isme tithi aur kram dono yaad rakhne padte hain. Shastriya bhasha ka darja dene ke liye kendriya sanskriti mantralay ki ek samiti sifarish karti hai. Exam point: shastriya bhasha ka kram - Tamil (2004), Sanskrit (2005), Telugu-Kannada (2008), Malayalam (2013), Odia (2014).

qe: Which two heritage properties of Bihar figure on the UNESCO World Heritage List?
qh: बिहार की कौन-सी दो धरोहरें यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर सूची में शामिल हैं?
oe: Mahabodhi Temple Complex, Bodh Gaya and Nalanda Mahavihara
oh: महाबोधि मंदिर परिसर, बोधगया तथा नालंदा महाविहार
e: Bihar ki do samparoharashiyan UNESCO World Heritage List me shaamil hain. Pehli - Mahabodhi Temple Complex, Bodh Gaya; ise 2002 me shaamil kiya gaya, kyunki Bhagwan Buddha ko isi sthan par gyaan (bodhi) prapt hua tha aur yahan ka temple third century BCE ke Ashok ke samay se juda hai. Doosri - Nalanda Mahavihara; ise 2016 me shaamil kiya gaya, kyunki yah duniya ka pramukh prachin vidya-kendra tha jahan kai deshon ke vidyarthi padhne aate the. Vikramshila Mahavihara ek pramukh prachin vishwavidyalaya tha, lekin woh abhi World Heritage List me nahi hai, isliye usse jodne wala vikalp galat hai. Barabar Caves (Maurya-kaleen) aur Golghar (1786, Patna) mahatvapurn dharohar hain, par unhe UNESCO ka darja nahi mila; Patna Museum bhi ek sangrahalaya hai. Exam point: Bihar ke do UNESCO sites = Mahabodhi Temple Complex, Bodh Gaya (2002) tatha Nalanda Mahavihara (2016).

qe: The folk dance 'Bidesiya' of Bihar belongs to which region and expresses which theme?
qh: बिहार का लोकनृत्य 'बिदेसिया' किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है और किस भावना को व्यक्त करता है?
oe: Mithila region; celebration of the first rainfall
Bhojpuri region; the pain of separation of a wife whose husband has migrated to the city
Magadh region; the martial spirit of soldiers
Kosi region; worship of the snake deity
oh: मिथिला क्षेत्र; पहली वर्षा का उत्सव
भोजपुरी क्षेत्र; उस पत्नी की विरह-वेदना जिसका पति शहर में काम करने गया है
मगध क्षेत्र; सैनिकों की वीर भावना
कोसी क्षेत्र; नाग देवता की पूजा
e: Bidesiya Bihar ke Bhojpuri anchal ka bahut prasiddh lok-nritya tatha lokgeet hai. Iska mool bhaav virah hai - pati rozgar ke liye shehar ya bahar (bides) chala jaata hai aur patni uski yaad me geet gaati hai; isi wajah se isme karuna tatha viyog ki bhavna prabal hoti hai. Iska nikat ka sambandh Bhikhari Thakur ki Rachnaon se hai, jinhone 'Bidesiya' natak likha aur Bhojpuri rangmanch ko naya roop diya. Mithila anchal ka prasiddh nritya Jat-Jatin hai, jo pati-patni ke jhagde aur punar-milan ki kahani dikhata hai; varsha ka sambandh Jhijhian (Indra ki puja) se hai, isliye pehla aur teesra vikalp sambandhit anchal ke sath galat jodi ban jaate hain. Magadh ki veer-bhavna wale nritya Paika hai aur Kosi anchal me Nag-puja se juda nritya alag hai. Exam point: Bidesiya = Bhojpuri anchal, virah (separation) ka nritya-geet; Jat-Jatin = Mithila, Paika = Magadh ki veerta, Jhijhian = varsha ke liye Indra-puja.

qe: Which famous painting style of Bihar, characterised by figures with large eyes and no blank space, received a Geographical Indication (GI) tag?
qh: बिहार की कौन-सी प्रसिद्ध चित्रकला शैली, जिसमें बड़ी आँखों वाली आकृतियाँ तथा खाली स्थान का अभाव होता है, को भौगोलिक संकेत (GI) टैग मिला?
e: Madhubani (Mithila) painting Bihar ki sabse prasiddh lok-chitrakala hai, jo Mithila anchal - Madhubani, Darbhanga, Saharsa, Sitamarhi jile - me banai jaati hai. Iski pehchan hai bade-bade nainan wali aakritiyan, koi ujaa jagah na chhodna (blank space nahi), aur gehra rang jaise laal, peela, hara tatha neela; vishay me Ram-Sita ki vivah gatha, Krishna, Durga tatha prakritik drishya aate hain. Isi khas pehchan ke karan ise 2007-08 me Geographical Indication (GI) tag mila. Patna Kalam ek Mughal-kalin chitrakala shaili hai jo Patna me vikasit hui, lekin yah GI-listed Mithila kala nahi hai. Sanjhi art mathura-brindavan ki kagaz-katayi kala hai aur Manjusha art Bhagalpur areas ki tala-patra (box) kala hai; dono alag kalaayein hain, isliye yeh vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Madhubani/Mithila painting = Bihar, bade nainan aur bhare hue chitra-sthal ki khas pehchan, GI tag 2007-08.

qe: Nalanda Mahavihara, the ancient centre of learning whose ruins are in present-day Bihar, was established by a ruler of which dynasty?
qh: प्राचीन शिक्षा-केंद्र नालंदा महाविहार, जिसके अवशेष वर्तमान बिहार में हैं, किस राजवंश के शासक द्वारा स्थापित किया गया?
e: Nalanda Mahavihara ki sthapna fifth century CE me Gupta shasak Kumaragupta I (shaskakal lagbhag 415-455 CE) ne ki, aur yahan Buddhist shiksha ki vishwa-prasiddh parampara chali. Isme baad ke shasak Harshavardhan tatha Pala rajaon ne bhi dan diya, aur saatvin sadi me aaye Chinese yatri Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang) ne yahan padhai tatha karyapranali ka vistrit varnan kiya. 1193 ke aas-paas Bakhtiyar Khilji ke hamle se yah mahavihara nasht ho gaya. Ashoka ko yahan se jodna galat hai kyunki Ashok ka sambandh Bodh Gaya aur Barabar caves se zyada hai; Kumaragupta I ke paas aane se pehle ka koi sthapna-abhilekh nahi milta, isliye pehla vikalp aur Samudragupta wala vikalp bhi sahih nahi hai. Pala rajaon ne ise vikasit kiya, sthapit nahi kiya, isliye pala wala vikalp bhi galat hai. Exam point: Nalanda Mahavihara = Kumaragupta I (Gupta vansh), Xuanzang ka varnan, 1193 me Khilji ke hamle se vinash, 2016 me UNESCO site.

qe: At the time of integration of the princely states after Independence, the instrument through which a ruler of a princely state agreed to transfer defence, external affairs and communications to the Dominion of India was:
qh: स्वतंत्रता के बाद रियासतों के एकीकरण के समय जिस दस्तावेज के माध्यम से किसी रियासत के शासक ने रक्षा, विदेशी मामले तथा संचार के विषय भारत अधिराज्य को सौंपने पर सहमति दी, वह था -
e: Svatantrata ke samay 500 se adhik riyasatein thi aur unhe bharat me jodna ek bada sangathanik kaam tha. Iske liye Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ke netritva me States Department (Riyasat Vibhag) bana, aur iske prashasanik adhikari V.P. Menon the. Kisi bhi riyasat ke shasak se 'Instrument of Accession' par hastakshar karaya jaata tha, jisme woh raksha, videshi mamle aur sanchar ke teen vishay Dominion of India ko saunpne par sahamat hota tha; baaki andaruni mamle uske paas hi rehte the. Standstill Agreement ek arbas par chhota samjhauta tha jisme yatra, daki tatha sanchar ki vyavastha chaloo rakhne ki baat thi - woh tatkalin intezaam ka upaay tha, riyasat ko bharat me milane ka dastavez nahi. 'Letter of Merger' aur 'Covenant of Integration' sanvidhanik ya aise pramanik naam nahi hain, isliye woh vikalp galat hain. Kai riyasaton jaise Junagadh, Hyderabad aur Kashmir me yah prakriya vivaadon ke saath poori hui. Exam point: riyasat ko bharat me jodne ka dastavez = Instrument of Accession; Sardar Patel ke States Department aur V.P. Menon iska pramukh nam.

qe: India's First Five Year Plan (1951-56) was primarily focused on which sector, and what was its broad strategy?
qh: भारत की प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-56) मुख्यतः किस क्षेत्र पर केंद्रित थी और उसकी व्यापक रणनीति क्या थी?
oe: Industry; rapid heavy industrialisation through public sector steel plants
Agriculture; increasing food production and correcting the effect of Partition on food supply
Services; expanding banking and insurance in rural areas
Infrastructure; building ports and highways for export trade
oh: उद्योग; सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के इस्पात संयंत्रों द्वारा द्रुत भारी औद्योगीकरण
कृषि; खाद्यान्न उत्पादन बढ़ाना तथा विभाजन से खाद्य आपूर्ति पर हुए प्रभाव को दूर करना
सेवाएँ; ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बैंकिंग तथा बीमा का विस्तार
अधोसंरचना; निर्यात व्यापार के लिए पत्तन तथा राजमार्ग बनाना
e: Pehli Panchvarshiya Yojana 1951 se 1956 tak chali aur iska bhar krishi tatha sinchai par tha. Vibhajan ke baad bharat ka ek bada hissa khadyan utpadan karne wala (Punjab ke kuch hisse) Pakistan ke paas chala gaya tha, isliye desh me khadyan ki bahut kami thi; khoobi se yahi samay Africa, Europe tatha Asia ke kai deshon me bhi khadyan sankat tha. Isliye plan ka lakshya khadyan utpadan badhana, kheti me sinchai aur bhumi-sudhar ke kary karana tatha keemat-sthirata rakhna tha. Bhari udyog, ispat talaye aur bahu-bade priyojnaon par jor doosri Panchvarshiya Yojana (1956-61) ka mukhya tattva tha, jo Mahalanobis model par bana; isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. Teesre tatha chauthi yojna mein soc arythvayvastha ke suchak tay kiye jaate hain, aur bank-rashtraiyan bhi 1969 ke baad aaya; isliye bima-sanchay wala vikalp bhi galat hai. Exam point: pehli yojana (1951-56) = krishi tatha sinchai; doosri yojana (1956-61) = bhari udyog aur Mahalanobis model.

qe: The state of Punjab was reorganised in 1966 on the recommendation of which commission, resulting in the creation of which new states?
qh: 1966 में पंजाब राज्य का पुनर्गठन किस आयोग की सिफारिश पर हुआ, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप कौन-से नए राज्य बने?
oe: Fazl Ali Commission; Punjab, Haryana and Himachal Pradesh
oh: फजल अली आयोग; पंजाब, हरियाणा तथा हिमाचल प्रदेश
e: Punjab me Punjabi tatha Hindi bolne walon ke beech bhasha ke aadhaar par rajya-batware ki maang 1950 ke dashak se chali aa rahi thi. 1966 me Parliamentary Committee ke adhyaksh Hukam Singh ki sifarish par Sant Fateh Singh ke anshan ke baad Shah Commission (adhyaksh: J.C. Shah) bani; uski sifarish par 1 November 1966 ko Punjab ka punargathan hua - Punjabi bhashi kshetra Punjab raha aur Haryanvi/Hindi bhashi kshetra se naya rajya Haryana bana; kuch pahadi kshetra Himachal Pradesh me mila diye gaye. Chandigarh ko sangh kshetra banakar dono rajyon ki rajdhani banaya gaya. Fazl Ali Commission 1953-55 ki thi jo 1956 ke rajya punargathan se judi hai, isliye Punjab ke liye uska naam lena galat hai. Sarkaria Commission (1983) kendra-rajya sambandhon ki thi aur Mudaliar Commission (1952-53) shiksha sudhar se judi thi; inka Punjab ke punargathan se koi lena-dena nahi hai. Exam point: 1966 ka Punjab punargathan = Shah Commission; Punjab tatha Haryana bane, Chandigarh sangh kshetra banakar dono ki rajdhani.

qe: Sikkim became the 22nd state of the Indian Union in 1975 by which constitutional amendment?
qh: सिक्किम 1975 में किस संवैधानिक संशोधन द्वारा भारतीय संघ का 22वाँ राज्य बना?
e: Sikkim pehle ek riyasat thi jiska bharat ke saath 1950 ka Special Treaty tha. 1974 me Sikkim Government Act aaya jisne ise associate state ka darja diya aur wahan rajya parishad tatha mantri parishad ki vyavastha banai; isi ke tehat chunav hua. 1975 me janmat sangrah ke baad rajya parishad ne bharat me vilay ka faisla kiya, aur 36th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1975 ke tehat Sikkim ko bharat ka 22nd rajya banaya gaya - usi ke saath pehli anusuchi me iska naam jura aur Article 371F vishesh pravdhan ke roop me joda gaya (jo purane sanghvanshi kanoon ko surakshit rakhta hai). 35th Amendment 1974 me Sikkim ko associate state banane ke liye tha, rajya banane ke liye nahi - isliye pehla vikalp aadha sahi lagta hai par prashn ke 'rajya banne' wale hisse ka jawab nahi hai. 42nd (1976) aur 44th (1978) Amendment kai anya vishyon se juda hai, jaise mini-constitution ke naam se prasiddh 42nd sanshodhan tatha sampatti ke adhikar ko hataaye jaane wala 44th sanshodhan. Exam point: Sikkim = 36th Amendment, 1975, 22nd rajya; Article 371F; pehla kadam 1974 me 35th Amendment se associate state ka darja.

qe: Goa, which was a Portuguese colony, was liberated by India through which operation in 1961?
qh: पुर्तगाली उपनिवेश गोवा को भारत ने 1961 में किस सैन्य अभियान द्वारा मुक्त कराया?
e: Portugal ka Goa, Daman, Diu tatha Dadra-Nagar Haveli par raaj 1947 ke baad bhi jaari raha. Bharatiya sarkar ne sabse pehle 1954 me Dadra-Nagar Haveli ko apne adhikar me liya, aur 1961 me jab Portugal ne shantipurn sunne se inkar kiya, tab sena ne December 1961 me 'Operation Vijay' ke tehat Goa, Daman tatha Diu ko mukt karaya - 19 December 1961 ko Goa bharat ka hissa ban gaya. 1987 me Goa ko pura rajya ka darja mila aur Daman-Diu tatha Dadra-Nagar Haveli alag sangh kshetra ban gaye. Operation Polo 1948 me Hyderabad riyasat ko bharat me jodne ke liye chalaya gaya tha, isliye woh is prashn ka jawab nahi hai. Operation Blue Star (1984) Amritsar ke Harmandir Sahib se juda tha aur Operation Meghdoot (1984) Siachen par bharat ke adhikar se juda tha; dono Goa se alag hain. Exam point: Goa muktikaran = Operation Vijay, December 1961 (19 December 1961 Goa Day); 1987 me Goa pura rajya bana.

qe: The National Emergency that gave rise to the phrase 'dark period of Indian democracy' was in force for which period, following which the 42nd Amendment was passed?
qh: जिस राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल को 'भारतीय लोकतंत्र का काला दौर' कहा जाता है, वह किस अवधि में प्रभावी रहा, जिसके बाद 42वाँ संशोधन पारित हुआ?
e: 25 June 1975 ki raat ko rashtrapati ne Article 352 ke tehat internal disturbance ke aadhaar par rashtriya aapatkal ki ghoshna ki; nirnay ke baad 26 June 1975 se aapatkal lagu hua. Yeh karib 21 mahine chala aur 21 March 1977 ko hata diya gaya; usi ke baad 1977 me aam chunav hue, jisme Janata Party satta me aayi. 42nd Amendment itihas me sabse vistrit sanshodhan maana jaata hai; usne loktantra aur sanvidhanik vyavastha me bahut se badlav kiye (jaise aapatkal ke pravdhan kadi karna, vidhayi shaktiyan badhana). Isliye saal '1979' ya aapatkal ko 1971-73 tak batana galat hai. 1971 ka samay Pakistan ke saath yuddh tatha 1971 ke aam chunav se juda hai, koi rashtriya aapatkal nahi. Bahut se log 'Emergency ki shuruat 26 June' keh dete hain lekin ghoshna 25 June ki raat ko hui thi aur lagu hone ki tareekh 26 June hai. Exam point: rashtriya aapatkal = 26 June 1975 se 21 March 1977 (karib 21 mahine), uske baad 42nd Amendment aur 1977 ke chunav.

qe: Who led the Green Revolution in India, which made the country self-sufficient in food grains, and which crop was central to it?
qh: भारत को खाद्यान्न में आत्मनिर्भर बनाने वाली हरित क्रांति का नेतृत्व किसने किया तथा उसमें कौन-सी फसल केंद्रीय थी?
e: Chathis ke dashak me bharat me khadyan ki ghor kami thi aur khadyan aayat par nirbhrta badh rahi thi. Acharya M.S. Swaminathan (jinhe bharat me Green Revolution ka janmdata kaha jaata hai) ne IARI aur uncha paidaar beejon wali HYV technology ko krishkon tak pahunchaya; Norman Borlaug ki vikasit dwarf wheat kismon ne is kaam ko bal diya. Hari kranti ka kendra bic hii thi - Punjab, Haryana tatha pashchim Uttar Pradesh me sinchai aur khad ke saath HYV bic bon kar khadyan utpadan kai guna badha, jisse bharat 1970 ke dashak me khadyan me atmanirbhar hota gaya. Chaval par jor baad se aaya, isliye 'Norman Borlaug aur chaval' wala vikalp galat hai; Borlaug ka naam wheat-based HYV technology ke liye prasiddh hai. Verghese Kurien ne 'shwet kranti' (white revolution) ka netritva kiya aur Amul dairy andolan ko khada kiya - woh doodh se juda hai. William Gaud ne 'Green Revolution' shabd ka prayog kiya tha, lekin woh bharat ke andolan ke neta nahi the. Exam point: hari kranti = M.S. Swaminathan (gehun), shwet kranti = Verghese Kurien (doodh), aur Norman Borlaug wheat salakar ke roop me jure.
